'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Alexander Kennedy LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alexander Kennedy]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Courting Disaster
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
